// NEGATIVE fixture — `globalThis.fetch` only where a lexer must not see it.
import { fetchCompat } from '../../../lib/fetch-compat.mjs';

// A line comment: globalThis.fetch(url)
/* A block comment: globalThis.fetch(url) */
const SINGLE = 'globalThis.fetch(url)';
const DOUBLE = "globalThis.fetch(url)";
const TEMPLATE = `call fetchCompat(url), never globalThis.fetch(url)`;
const IN_REGEX = /globalThis\.fetch\b/;

export function mentionsGlobalFetch(source) {
  return /globalThis\.fetch\b/.test(source);
}

export function get(url) {
  // Near-miss in real code: the word boundary does not fire between `fetch` and `C`.
  const probe = globalThis.fetchCompatProbe;
  void probe;
  return fetchCompat(url);
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
